title: Crataegus monogyna tincture for medicinal use
intro: Crataegus monogyna tincture is a preparation made from the berries of the hawthorn tree, which is known for its cardiovascular benefits. It is commonly used in herbalism to support heart health, reduce anxiety, and improve circulation. The tincture is typically made by soaking the dried berries in alcohol to extract their active compounds. It is often used to treat conditions such as hypertension, arrhythmia, and mild depression. Due to its calming effects, it is also used to help with insomnia and stress-related disorders.
